messages:
nina: Quick plan 103: Launching a "Kudos Kiosk" pop-up this Fri to hand out recognition cards + $10 vouchers + sticker packs. Need volunteers, supply owner, and confirmation on payroll/tax timeline for vouchers. Also a remote mail plan. who can help?

jamal: I'm happy to do remote fulfillment (mail + e-gift codes). do we have an RSVP headcount target?

carol: I can cover onsite Fri 14:00-16:00. Can we ensure the table is in the accessible hallway?

frank: I can order envelopes, labels, and a small badge sign. procurement question: who owns the voucher purchase?

nina: Procurement note: we need a PO by Wed COB. HR ops: vouchers must be entered by Thu noon to appear on the payroll memo. Remote e-gifts ok if they ship same day.

hr-bot: FYI: Awards reporting policy: awards > $25 are taxable and require reporting. See https://redwood.team/hr/awards-policy. For questions DM payroll.

jamal: For remote folks I'll prep a spreadsheet with addresses + opt-in e-gift column. I'll also ask payroll if AWDS-FY24 code is okay or if we need a new cost center.

carol: I can design bilingual cards (EN/ES) and print a small run. prefer to use recycled cardstock.

nina: Proposed shifts (flex volunteers):
```
Fri 09:30-11:00
Fri 11:30-13:00
Fri 14:00-16:00
```

frank: I'll take 11:30-13:00 and handle table signage + label printer.

jamal: I'll handle remote mail drops after the event; courier pickup scheduled Sat morning if needed.

nina: Task list (quick):
- jamal: remote fulfillment + e-gift codes + address spreadsheet
- frank: supplies (envelopes, labels, badge, table sign) + procurement coord
- carol: bilingual note design + assemble cards
- nina: PO + payroll coordination + post in #all-hands + calendar event

ops-bot: Office-ops reminder: No loose confetti in main floor (carpet). Recommend paper streamer packs or reusable confetti alternatives. Also confirm 12x folding chairs and 1x 6ft table.

carol: Noted re confetti. I'll design signage that calls out accessibility and remote options.

jamal: Quick timeline question: nomination cutoff for same-week vouchers?

hr-bot: Nomination cutoff: Thu 23:59 local timezone to make this week's issuance. Late noms roll to next payroll cycle.

nina: Great. I'll post RSVP + short FAQ in #all-hands and include remote opt-in link. Will also include: how awards are reported for taxes, and contact for payroll questions.

frank: One small ask: can we mark 10 vouchers as "remote only" for people who can't attend? saves on physical handouts.

nina: Good idea. jamal will handle remote codes. final checklist I'll publish tomorrow AM with who brings what. thanks all :tada: 

nina: (pinning) follow-ups: confirm PO submitted, confirm payroll code, confirm courier pickup time. I'll tag people once done.
